verses.gurmukhi: ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਕੋ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: namasakaar gurdhev ko sat naam jis ma(n)tr sunaiaa|

en.bdb: I bow before the Guru (Guru Nanak Dev) who recited the Satnam mantra (for the world).

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਵਜਲ ਵਿਚੋਂ ਕਢਿ ਕੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਦਾਰਥਿ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: bhavajal vicho(n) kadd kai mukat padhaarath maeh samaiaa|

en.bdb: Getting (the creatures) across the world ocean He raptly merged them in liberation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭਉ ਕਟਿਆ ਸੰਸਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਵਿਯੋਗੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: janam maran bhau kaTiaa sa(n)saa rog viyog miTaiaa|

en.bdb: He destroyed the fear of transmigration and decimated the malady of doubt and separation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਵਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: sa(n)saa ih sa(n)saar hai janam maran vich dhukh savaiaa|

en.bdb: The world is only illusion which carried with it much of birth, death and sufferings.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਦੰਡੁ ਸਿਰੌਂ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਸਾਕਤਿ ਦੁਰਜਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: jam dha(n)dd siraua(n) na utarai saakat dhurajan janam gavaiaa|

en.bdb: The fear of the rod of Yama is not dispelled and the sakts, the followers of the goddess, have lost their lives in vain.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਗਹੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਦੇ ਸਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਦੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: charan gahe gurdhev dhe sat sabadh dhe mukat karaiaa|

en.bdb: Those who have caught hold of the feet of the Guru have been liberated through the true Word.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜ੍ਹਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: bhaau bhagat gurapurab kar naam dhaan isanaan dhiraRhaiaa|

en.bdb: Now being full of loving devotion they celebrate the gurprubs (anniversaries of the Gurus) and their acts of rememberance of God, charity and holy ablutions, inspire others also.
As someone sows, so he reaps.
